text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526175

g.text: Each dot uses the high-load, outside-band subset of 768 retained logged probes (200–232 rows here).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526175

g.text: Inward means the negative first-action loss gradient points toward the band; it is not an executed actor movement.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526175

g.text: Native penalty is zero and omitted in the bottom row. The mask is a construction label, not proof of local or joint support.
